in_sanskrit.name: द्रुविथान्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: Dharma (law, moral order) + Vitha (wisdom) + Ansh (sign, symbol, essence)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who embodies the essence of dharma (law, moral order) and possesses great wisdom.

in_hindi.name: द्रुविथान्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: द्रुवि (द्रव्य, धर्म) + थान्श (विद्या, विज्ञान + अन्न,न, अन्नकर्ता) = द्रुविथान्श One who possesses wisdom and knowledge (Vitha) and embodies the essence of Dharma (law, moral order, dharma) and is a giver of food and nourishment (Ansh, Annayan, Annakarta).

in_tamil.name: திருவிதாஞ்சம்
in_tamil.meaning: திரு (Dharma, moral law) + விதா (Vitha, wisdom) + ஞ்சம் (Ansh, essence)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who embodies the essence of moral law (Dharma) and possesses great wisdom (Vitha).

in_telugu.name: ద్రువిథాన్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who possesses wisdom and knowledge (Vidhyayudhudhesham, Vijjadeesham) and embodies the essence of Dharma (धर्म) and is a giver of food and nourishment (Anna-dhesham, Annadhesham).

in_marathi.name: Druvithansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Druvithansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Druvithansh is derived from the words ‘Druv’ meaning sun, star and ‘Ithansh’ meaning Lord of Gods, Indra. It is believed that this name was given to the sage Druvasena, the father of the great hero Bhagiratha who brought Lord Shiva down to the earth to absolve the sins of his ancestors.

in_bengali.name: Druvithansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun, Star
in_bengali.long_meaning: Druvithansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Druvithansh is derived from the words ‘Druv’ meaning sun, star and ‘Ithansh’ meaning Lord of Gods, Indra. It is believed that this name was given to the sage Druvasena, the father of the great hero Bhagiratha who brought Lord Shiva down to the earth to absolve the sins of his ancestors.
